question: Under the same KD scaffold and tuning budget, does SSR improve retention and hard-confusion margins while keeping semantic-neighbour disruption within 1 pp?

protocol.question: Under the same KD scaffold and tuning budget, does SSR improve retention and hard-confusion margins while keeping semantic-neighbour disruption within 1 pp?

selection.selection_rule: For each family, prefer positive mean AA and AF changes versus KD; then maximize the weaker endpoint, dual wins and endpoint sum. Mechanism metrics are not used.

naming_guardrail: center_component is the attractive component of SSR, not classical supervised Center Loss.
